result.stdout:
USAGE:
    gamekit [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    migrate          Apply GameKit Core migrations against the configured       
                     Postgres (backwards-compatible shorthand; for all packages 
                     use 'gamekit migrations apply')                            
    admin            Admin operations (superadmin bootstrap, admin CRUD)        
    service-token    Service-account bearer token operations (issue, revoke,    
                     list)                                                      
    db               Database backup and restore helpers (wraps                 
                     pg_dump/pg_restore). Prerequisite: pg_dump and pg_restore  
                     must be on the operator's PATH                             
    migrations       Multi-package migration status and apply tooling           
                     (DR-04/DR-05). Covers all 6 GameKit packages in canonical  
                     order: Core, Auth, Admin, Rankings, Matchmaking, Lobby

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Database backup and restore helpers (wraps pg_dump/pg_restore). Prerequisite: 
pg_dump and pg_restore must be on the operator's PATH.

USAGE:
    gamekit db [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    backup     Backup Postgres to a file via pg_dump (--format=custom).         
               Optionally issues a Redis BGSAVE. pg_dump must be on the         
               operator's PATH                                                  
    restore    Restore Postgres from a pg_dump custom-format file via           
               pg_restore. Requires explicit --database to prevent accidental   
               restore into the wrong DB. pg_restore must be on the operator's  
               PATH

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Create an admin user (interactive or flag-driven). First admin auto-promoted to 
superadmin.

USAGE:
    gamekit admin create [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
                                      DEFAULT                                   
    -h, --help                                   Prints help information        
    -u, --username <USERNAME>                    Username (3-32 chars,          
                                                 case-insensitive). Prompted    
                                                 when omitted                   
    -p, --password <PASSWORD>                    Password (>= 8 chars). Prompted
                                                 without echo when omitted on a 
                                                 TTY. Falls back to env         
                                                 GAMEKIT_ADMIN_PASSWORD in      
                                                 non-TTY contexts               
    -r, --role <ROLE>                 admin      Role: admin or superadmin.     
                                                 Ignored for the first admin    
                                                 (auto-promoted to superadmin)  
    -c, --connection-string <CONN>               Postgres connection string     
                                                 (gamekit_owner role            
                                                 recommended)

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Mint a new service-account bearer token. Raw token printed once — store it 
securely.

USAGE:
    gamekit service-token issue [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                        Prints help information                   
    -n, --name <NAME>                 Label for this service token (e.g.        
                                      "game-server-prod"). Must be unique       
        --expires <DURATION>          Optional expiry as ISO-8601 duration (e.g.
                                      P30D) or UTC datetime (e.g.               
                                      2027-01-01T00:00:00Z)                     
    -c, --connection-string <CONN>    Postgres connection string. Falls back to 
                                      GAMEKIT_CONNECTION env var

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Backup Postgres to a file via pg_dump (--format=custom). Optionally issues a 
Redis BGSAVE. pg_dump must be on the operator's PATH.

USAGE:
    gamekit db backup [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                        Prints help information                   
    -c, --connection-string <CONN>    Postgres connection string. Falls back to 
                                      GAMEKIT_MIGRATIONS_CONNECTION /           
                                      GAMEKIT_CONNECTION                        
    -o, --output <PATH>               Absolute path for the pg_dump output file 
                                      (e.g. /srv/backups/game.pgdump). Required 
    -r, --redis-connection <CONN>     Redis connection string (e.g.             
                                      localhost:6379). When supplied, issues    
                                      BGSAVE to snapshot Redis

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Restore Postgres from a pg_dump custom-format file via pg_restore. Requires 
explicit --database to prevent accidental restore into the wrong DB. pg_restore 
must be on the operator's PATH.

USAGE:
    gamekit db restore [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                        Prints help information                   
    -c, --connection-string <CONN>    Postgres connection string. Falls back to 
                                      GAMEKIT_MIGRATIONS_CONNECTION /           
                                      GAMEKIT_CONNECTION                        
    -f, --file <PATH>                 Absolute path to the pg_dump custom-format
                                      dump file to restore. Required            
    -d, --database <NAME>             Explicit target database name. Required — 
                                      prevents silent restore into the wrong DB 
                                      (T-17-04-03)
